concord-new-mariner.title: CONCORD – NEW MARINER
concord-new-mariner.description: To accompany the launch of the new Mariner Collection, Concord invites you on a journey to the heart of Lake Biel and its surrounding landscapes, where water, light and time come together.

info.label: CREDITS
info.text:
Director
Sebastian Bouet
DOP
Romain Do

concord-new-mariner.summary: The film captures a suspended moment, intimate and mysterious, where horizons shift and time seems to slow down. A subtle escape shaped by movement and contemplation, where every passing moment becomes a memory. Blending watchmaking precision, timeless elegance and a spirit of discovery, Concord offers a poetic expression of its Swiss identity. A story where time is no longer simply measured, but truly felt.

ebel-1911-chronograph-ice-blue.summary: Shot in studio, the campaign explores contrasts through light, shadow, and materials. A refined visual treatment combining macro details, cinematic compositions, and the versatility of the interchangeable bracelet system.

items.description: A film marking 115 years of Ebel, built around the Sport Classic. Shot in light-filled architectural interiors, it lets the maison’s signature wave bracelet move quietly through a world of timeless elegance.

ebel-sport-classic-115th.summary: 115 years, one unmistakable line. Ebel calls itself the architect of time, so we placed the Sport Classic where it belongs: inside spaces of pure architecture and soft natural light. No reinvention, just an icon that has never needed to change.

franck-muller-watchland.title: FRANCK MULLER – WATCHLAND
franck-muller-watchland.description: A craft film set inside Watchland, Franck Muller’s lakeside estate where every watchmaking métier lives under one roof. We followed a piece from first sketch to final stone, letting the place and its hands tell the story.

info.label: CREDITS
info.text:
Director
Nabil Senhaji
DOP
David Montcher

franck-muller-watchland.summary: Most maisons scatter their craft across the valley. Franck Muller brought it all to Watchland, one estate above Lake Geneva where design, watchmaking and gem-setting meet. We filmed that convergence the way it deserves, human hands, warm light, and the patience every complication demands.

items.title: MB&F – HM11
items.description: A film for the HM11 Architect, MB&F’s house for the wrist. We set it down in a vast desert and shot it like a building, not a watch, playing on scale until the machine becomes a world of its own.

items.title: NESCENS x LA RESERVE
items.description: Where advanced science meets the art of hospitality. The campaign presents the Nescens Better-Aging programmes at La Réserve Genève, combining medical expertise, innovative treatments and a deeply personal approach to wConceptell-being.

jaeger-lecoultre-holiday-reverso-23.title: JAEGER-LECOULTRE – HOLIDAYS REVERSO 23
jaeger-lecoultre-holiday-reverso-23.description: Inspired by three floral creations imagined by Brendi Wedinger and rooted in the landscapes of the Vallée de Joux, the campaign brings together product, craftsmanship and worn moments within one continuous visual language.

info.label: CREDITS
info.text:
Director
Guillaume Allantaz
DOP
Jonathan Grimault
Photographer
Jérémy Josselin

jaeger-lecoultre-holiday-reverso-23.summary: From silhouettes to watchmaking gestures and product details, every scene is shaped by the colors, textures and atmosphere of the flowers. Using virtual production, reflective surfaces and controlled backlighting, the film creates an abstract and constantly evolving environment where light becomes a transition between worlds. A motion control system allows the camera to move seamlessly from the human gesture to the smallest details of the watch, creating a precise and fluid visual language that connects nature, craftsmanship and the Maison’s creations.

items.description: For Watches & Wonders 2026, the campaign reimagines the Vallée de Joux as a dreamlike stage, creating a visual world where landscape, movement and watchmaking come together through unexpected perspectives.

items.title: VACHERON CONSTANTIN – PATRIMONY 22
items.description: A film for the Patrimony, Vacheron Constantin’s purest expression of restraint. Soft light, slow movement, and nothing more than line and proportion, exactly the way the collection has always been designed.

jaeger-lecoultre-ww-26.description: For Watches & Wonders 2026, the campaign reimagines the Vallée de Joux as a dreamlike stage, creating a visual world where landscape, movement and watchmaking come together through unexpected perspectives.

jaeger-lecoultre-ww-26.summary: Entirely built in studio, the set offers an abstract interpretation of Jaeger LeCoultre’s birthplace. A circular scenography, sculptural rocks and atmospheric layers create depth while giving the camera complete freedom to move around the talent and the watch. Through ambitious camera movements and unusual points of view, the film shifts seamlessly between the body, the environment and the smallest product details. The result is an immersive and theatrical visual language, turning the Vallée de Joux into a contemporary expression of the Maison’s universe.

medicxi-seeker.title: MEDICXI – SEEKER
medicxi-seeker.description: Behind every medical breakthrough lies a long journey of conviction, resilience and collaboration. Seeker reveals the human reality of biotech innovation and the determination required to transform scientific ambition into life-changing treatments.

info.label: CREDITS
info.text:
Director
Adrien Wagner
ECD
Damien Real
Scriptwriter
Sebastiaan Vermeul
DOP
Ludovic Zuili

medicxi-seeker.summary: Developed through a close creative collaboration between Damien Real, Adrien Wagner and Sebastiaan Vermeul, the film combines cinematic storytelling with the authenticity of real scientific journeys. Moving between intimate human moments, research environments and visual metaphors, the campaign captures the uncertainty, setbacks and perseverance behind every breakthrough while revealing Medicxi’s long-term commitment to scientists and their vision.

lines: The Behind the Scenes reveals the scale of the production and the collective effort behind the film. From creative development to production and post production, a large team of collaborators brought together their expertise across direction, cinematography, art direction, production, VFX, sound and finishing. It offers a glimpse into the ambition of the project and the many talents required to bring Medicxi’s story to life.

nescens-x-la-reserve.description: Where advanced science meets the art of hospitality. The campaign presents the Nescens Better-Aging programmes at La Réserve Genève, combining medical expertise, innovative treatments and a deeply personal approach to wConceptell-being.

nescens-x-la-reserve.summary: Set within the peaceful surroundings of La Réserve Genève, the film creates a dialogue between recovery and performance. Lifestyle moments are interwoven with advanced protocols, from diagnostics and neuro-mapping to cryotherapy and hyperbaric treatments. Through a refined and sensory visual language, the campaign reveals a holistic experience designed to improve vitality, resilience and long-term health.

items.title: EBEL – 1911 CHRONOGRAPH ICE BLUE
items.description: A film for the 1911 Chronograph Ice Blue, built entirely on one contrast: cool against warm. Ice-blue light, amber shadow, and a dial that lives right on that line.

sartoro-winter.title: SARTORO – WINTER
sartoro-winter.description: A winter campaign shaped as a series of distinct visual moments. Through four scenettes, Sartoro’s jewellery is placed at the heart of an editorial world where elegance, playfulness and contemporary fashion codes come together.

info.label: CREDITS
info.text:
Director & Photographer
Guillaume Allantaz
DOP
Jonathan Grimault

sartoro-winter.summary: Entirely created in studio, the campaign embraces the artifice of its sets rather than hiding it. Each scene explores a different winter atmosphere while sharing a strong and cohesive visual language. Moving between wide shots revealing the full set and intimate details of the jewellery, the films play with scale, movement and unexpected camera perspectives. Somewhere between fashion editorial and behind the scenes, the campaign turns the studio itself into part of the storytelling, creating a bold and playful showcase for Sartoro’s pieces.

test-1-portail-des-nations.title: PORTAIL DES NATIONS
test-1-portail-des-nations.description: The world has been shaped here for decades. Now, for the first time, you can experience it from the inside.
test-1-portail-des-nations.summary: At the heart of the Portail des Nations in Geneva, we have created a groundbreaking immersive experience dedicated to multilateralism. Through interactive installations and sensory storytelling, visitors step into the inner workings of international diplomacy. Its stakes, its actors, its defining moments. An invitation to feel how nations listen, negotiate, and together build the rules that govern our world.
